name: What are common reasons a gate might stop working?

mainEntity.name: What are common reasons a gate might stop working?

acceptedAnswer.text: Gates can stop working for several common reasons, including motor issues, sensor malfunctions, track obstructions, or damage to the gate itself. For instance, cold weather in areas like Meridian or Eagle can sometimes affect motor performance or cause components to contract, leading to operational problems. Debris accumulating in tracks is also a frequent culprit, preventing smooth movement. Before contacting for service, inspecting the gate path for obvious obstacles can sometimes help resolve minor issues or provide valuable information for technicians.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common gate issues include motor problems, sensor malfunctions, track obstructions, or physical damage. Environmental factors like cold weather or debris can also cause gates to stop working.
